newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING no comment on Lehman buy rumours.
newsitem.headline: ING no comment on Lehman buy rumours.

text.p: Dutch banking and insurance group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Friday it had no comment on rumours it wanted to buy U.S. investment bank Lehman Brothers.
"We don't comment on rumours," ING spokesman Wieger Sietsma told Reuters.
The rumours had been circulating in New York and Chicago.
Sietsma said ING had previously indicated it would be useful to expand its securities distribution capacity in the United States.
"On that point, we have said that at some time in the future we might be interested in an acquisition that might bring us (that extra capacity)," he added.

ING is also involved in talks with its 25 percent owned U.S. investment bank Dillon, Read & Co over the possibility of buying the remaining 75 percent or selling its stake to the Dillon Read partners.
